title: Read a long build log
description: Use when a command prints more than a screen of text: let it scroll, then filter it with grep and clear the screen.
overview: cat prints a log that scrolls past the screen, grep narrows it to the errors, clear wipes the terminal.

steps.success_criteria: The log scrolls past; the last lines stay on screen.

evidence.quote: cat build.log prints the whole log

steps.success_criteria: Only the two error lines are printed.

evidence.quote: grep error build.log shows only the failures

steps.success_criteria: An empty terminal with a fresh prompt.
